Each file's module docstring describes what that service does and, in prose, how it connects to the others. Read all six files, then add an `## Architecture` section to `README.md` containing a single Mermaid diagram (fenced with ```mermaid) that shows all six components and the direction of the request/data flow between them. Keep node labels short and readable. Do not modify any files under `services/`.

assertions.text: The Mermaid diagram added to README.md includes a distinct node for each of the six components described in services/ (API Gateway, Auth Service, Core API, Background Worker, Job Queue, Primary Datastore) — not a generic, partial, or placeholder diagram.
